mapper.select: SELECT prj_id,cntrct_ty_cd,prj_stts_cd,use_yn FROM prj.prj WHERE prj_id=#{id}

SELECT p.prj_id,p.prj_no,p.prj_nm,c.ptnr_nm AS "custName",p.cntrct_ty_cd,p.bsn_part_id, coalesce(d.dev_nm,'PM 미지정') AS "pmName",p.cur_cntrct_amt,p.prfm_bgn_dt,p.trgt_cst_amt, m.wrt_dt AS last_memo_dt,m.actl_prgs_rt, (SELECT count(*) FROM prj.issue i WHERE i.prj_id=p.prj_id AND i.issue_stts_cd IN ('OPEN','DOING')) AS open_issue_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM prj.issue i WHERE i.prj_id=p.prj_id AND i.issue_stts_cd IN ('OPEN','DOING') AND i.svrt_cd='HIGH') AS high_open_issue_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM prj.issue i WHERE i.prj_id=p.prj_id AND i.issue_stts_cd!='CLOSED' AND i.ddln_dt < #{today}) AS overdue_issue_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM prj.issue i WHERE i.prj_id=p.prj_id AND i.issue_stts_cd!='CLOSED' AND i.ddln_dt < #{today} AND i.svrt_cd='HIGH') AS high_overdue_count FROM prj.prj p LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=p.cust_ptnr_id LEFT JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=p.pm_dev_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT wrt_dt,actl_prgs_rt FROM prj.wkly_memo w WHERE w.prj_id=p.prj_id ORDER BY wrt_dt DESC,memo_id DESC LIMIT 1) m ON true WHERE p.prj_id=#{id}
SELECT memo_id,prj_id,wrt_dt,actl_prgs_rt,cmpl_work_desc,plan_work_desc,rqst_desc FROM prj.wkly_memo WHERE prj_id=#{id} ORDER BY wrt_dt DESC,memo_id DESC

SELECT prj_id,ttl_nm,svrt_cd,chrg_nm,ddln_dt,issue_stts_cd,actn_desc,issue_id,reg_dt,end_dt FROM prj.issue WHERE prj_id=#{id} ORDER BY CASE WHEN issue_stts_cd='CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE svrt_cd WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 0 WHEN 'MID' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,ddln_dt NULLS LAST,issue_id
